description:
Take a walk on the milder side with Lou’s Kitchen Chicken Tikka Masala With Rice. This classic Indian-inspired entrée serves up tender chicken thigh morsels in a robust (but not overly spicy) tomato-butter curry sauce. We’re paired it with fluffy white rice for a complete, fully cooked meal that’s ready in as little as 4 minutes: just heat, pour and enjoy.

Lou’s Kitchen foods are prepared in Canada. We slow-cook our meals using the sous-vide method. Foods are cooked at lower temperatures for longer periods of time. Sealed in bags, this process seals in all the goodness lost in traditional cooking methods. Result: delicious, restaurant-quality flavours, and firm-yet-tender morsels you can really sink your teeth into.

name: Lou’s Kitchen Tandoori Chicken
description:
Lou’s Kitchen Tandoori Chicken delivers hot-from-the-tandoor flavour that’s ready in as little as 4 minutes. Our boneless chicken is marinated with traditional tandoori spices for a rich, authentic flavour, then slow cooked for optimal tenderness.

Our cooking technique mimics traditional tandoor cooking, resulting in juicy meat with a slightly crispy exterior. Serve our mouthwatering chicken with rice or naan, and the included yogurt-style dipping sauce.

Lou’s Kitchen foods are prepared in Canada using sous-vide cooking for low-and-slow cooking that retains all the flavours and quality of our recipes. Result: delicious, restaurant-quality flavours, and firm-yet-tender morsels you can really sink your teeth into.
